capabilities: show pinned tabs in a separate row above the tab bar
compact pinned tabs into an icon-only strip
pin or unpin the current tab by command
show or hide the pinned row
extras: Desktop only; has no effect on mobile since Obsidian hides the tab bar there.
problem: Obsidian mixes pinned and unpinned tabs in a single tab bar, so pinned tabs occupy space in the main row.
summary: Interface tweak that shows pinned tabs in a separate compact row above the normal tab bar, similar to VS Code and IntelliJ.
